title: Finite coefficient realizations with specified units
statement: For the module-object categories of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-category], define a finite-coefficient realization by an exact additive equivalence from internal modules over a pulled-back commutative condensed ring R to sheaves of modules over a specified ordinary commutative ring A. Retain the natural underlying-abelian-sheaf identification and a regular-module-to-constant-A unit isomorphism. The latter is normalized by a unital isomorphism of coefficient ring objects and the existing constant-sheaf/forgetful comparison. Define its degree-zero comparison into the unit presentation of [sk-lem-geo-p1-cohomology] using the existing exact comparison/single isomorphism and [sk-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x]'s constant-ring construction. A realization/direct-image square retains the ordinary natural isomorphism, its equality on underlying sheaves and its derived natural isomorphism normalized on every complex by the full universal right-derived units of [det-prop-diagonal-tower-trace]. This is normalized endpoint data; it does not assert an arbitrary condensed ring is finite constant.
